annotations.text: AUSTRIA'S CANDIDATE FOR THE THRONE OF ALBANIA.Our photo shows a charming group of the Urach family taken in the woods of their residence.Duke William of Urach,Count of Wurtemberg,who according to information from a reliable quarter(see Daily Telegraph's Vienna correspondent's wire(9/4) is being taken in view by Austria as the future Prince of Albania. Duke William who is a Catholic,was born at Monaco on March 1864 and is a son of the late Duke William and Princess Florestine of Monaco.He is a General in the Wurtemberg army and a knight of the Black Eagle.His wife General in the Duchess Amelie of Bavaria was a niece of the late Empress of Austri, she died last year.

Our photo shows Duke William of Urach and his late wife,surrounded by their children. Their names are,reading from left to right:- Princess Elizabeth,age 19,Prince Eberhard,Prince Charles,Prince Albert, Princess Margaret and Prince William(his heir).Queen Mary of England, being a Princess of Teck, is related to the Wurtemberg Royal family to whom Prince of Wales is now on a visit to Stuttgart,where the Urach fami resides.
